### Bug Fixes

* **bench:** hold the tokenizer fixed when attributing a pair to metadata ([c421096](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/c42109649bcf966aba8c6b13f67a1bbe194c7820))
* **bench:** make the dedup replay reproduce what it publishes ([da73266](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/da73266fcb8afcc13f6767dae3839b81a71cc445))
* **bench:** print every metadata-driven pair, and correct what they are ([341e839](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/341e83936b4f0b0306b225c4dba0260cadcbfe4e))
* **bench:** replay the pre-fc59b84 tokenizer, do not approximate it ([01f88e9](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/01f88e93127875cff2a28d6e61258bab4730047e))

# [0.33.0](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/compare/v0.32.0...v0.33.0) (2026-11-19)


### Bug Fixes

* **dedup:** a collapse outranks a group, and groups name rows that ride ([4588937](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/45889370c6560498c7980c89e028b14ab8e7f635))
* **dedup:** flag-off keeps the first-match rule, and a family gets one marker ([fe21276](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/fe212761d3603f05516971fdb88257b4436b8ea9))
* **gate:** edit ref fixes at their spans, and narrow the rename rule ([72dea23](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/72dea238b0394c12f8a24de00f90e43f32a62bef))
* **scripts:** a path reused after a rename is not repointed ([c76a431](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/c76a431dfe7e051a707d6461f79b4d455cabd568))
* **scripts:** a reused rename destination is not a safe target either ([882618c](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/882618c49c57205195f19dad299e0896749131f6))
* **scripts:** count creations, not touches, to spot a reused path ([4d95fc8](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/4d95fc8d8bb4358d93b3995f668edd074c0aeff0))
* **scripts:** refuse a path that was renamed twice ([8c63a26](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/8c63a265d209a5ce84317824d7f80491247a84b7))
* **scripts:** repair rows whose cited paths moved ([da8c43a](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/da8c43ad98e7094301475e4b4fb20d370b9d4375))


### Features

* **dedup:** keep an additive clash instead of collapsing it ([1d4abad](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/1d4abad8224be0a8b5e4bce5c5321464b53bcc66))
* **recall:** name a kept group with an AMBIGUOUS line ([8321e82](https://github.com/abogartz/opencode-self-improvement/commit/8321e82a8830bd371be136e987f50081b7caeae3))
